summary: Frontline health workers in low-resource settings can electronically register and track the health of their entire client population using this open source mobile health platform. The platform benefits healthcare workers, community health workers, patients, and clients. It operates in the context of community health and healthcare delivery in low-income countries. The project's impact is to improve healthcare data management and collection, enabling better health outcomes. It addresses the healthcare sector, with a focus on digital health and electronic health records.
